Top States by E-Way Bill Volume or Value

Source: R/functions.R
ewb_top_states.Rd

Top States by E-Way Bill Volume or Value

ewb_top_states(
  n = 10L,
  metric = c("ewb_count", "assessable_value"),
  direction = c("intrastate", "interstate_out", "interstate_in", "all"),
  financial_year = NULL
)

Arguments

n

integer. Number of states. Default 10L.

metric

character(1). "ewb_count" (default) or "assessable_value".

direction

character(1). "intrastate", "interstate_out", "interstate_in", or "all" (sum of all).

financial_year

character vector. NULL = all.

Value

A ranked data.table.

Examples

ewb_top_states(n = 5, financial_year = "2023-24")
#>     rank         state  region intrastate_ewb_count
#>    <int>        <char>  <char>                <num>
#> 1:     1   Maharashtra    West            699207644
#> 2:     2    Tamil Nadu   South            499609570
#> 3:     3     Karnataka   South            465373989
#> 4:     4       Gujarat    West            420496741
#> 5:     5 Uttar Pradesh Central            415985416
ewb_top_states(metric = "assessable_value", direction = "interstate_out",
               financial_year = "2023-24")
#>      rank          state  region interstate_out_assessable_value
#>     <int>         <char>  <char>                           <num>
#>  1:     1    Maharashtra    West                        13312738
#>  2:     2        Gujarat    West                        11376553
#>  3:     3     Tamil Nadu   South                         8029522
#>  4:     4        Haryana   North                         7562101
#>  5:     5  Uttar Pradesh Central                         6198476
#>  6:     6      Karnataka   South                         6114445
#>  7:     7          Delhi   North                         4324827
#>  8:     8      Rajasthan    West                         3758717
#>  9:     9    West Bengal    East                         3493895
#> 10:    10 Andhra Pradesh   South                         3366009
